Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Print Wall Art of Blue Geode Detail in Silver Frame, 13.75" x 13.75"
Colors: Silver
Materials: canvas
This modern treatment of a geode -- a naturally occurring ancient wonder -- features muted blue and green tones. Mounted in a floater frame, this contemporary piece is a wonderful accent to a mostly neutral-color room. Contemporary, sophisticated treatment of nature Hand-stretched canvas around engineered wood stretcher bar with floater frame in a silver finish; arrives ready to hang 13.75" x 13.75" Made to order
